record.text:
life update: I've recently left @Kimi_Moonshot!

The past year at Kimi has been the best of my life so far. I'm deeply grateful to have worked with and learned from such amazing and supportive colleagues.

Some of my favorite memories include (in chronological order): optimizing

fetch_manifest.scope: One known departure post only; syndication is not timeline coverage. Long-post text is a truncated preview.

static_review.scope: Read-only pre-execution source/test/README review with stdlib AST and SHA256; no production imports, Torch/model compute, tests, installations, tracked edits or network requests.
runtime_limitations: Static review does not execute nested-hook behavior or numerical tests. Root owns test/model execution.
Pack/unpack counts count saved operands; multiple saves per LayerNorm are expected. The guard checks exactly one forward call and at least one save/unpack.
Pre-execution status and timestamp record are local evidence; filesystem timestamps are not cryptographic proof of historical immutability.
recommended_result_checks: Compare actual dense/model_saved gradients and forwards against prior043511 fixed batches as a baseline invariance cross-check.
Recompute all aggregate gradient metrics, gate outcomes and worker/report hashes from retained actual results before publication.

independent_result_review.scope: Independent stdlib readback of retained raw results, report identity, hashes, metrics arithmetic and exact prior043511 dense/model-int8 baseline gradient equivalence. No model execution, Torch imports or gradient-array regeneration.

gate.meaning: predeclared named-LayerNorm saved-operand sensitivity gate; no training-quality implication
predeclared named-LayerNorm saved-operand sensitivity gate; no training-quality implication
predeclared named-LayerNorm saved-operand sensitivity gate; no training-quality implication

audit_processing.scope: Reviewer-only processing correction; no experimental source/protocol/data/output changes or model/test rerun.
audit_processing.initial_findings: Nine audit assertions used shape alone to identify CE saves and rejected protected output-head parameter aliases of the same [128,50304] shape. These were reviewer assertion errors, not experiment control failures.
audit_processing.correction: Restrict shape check to eligible activation saves, consistent with the prior gradient audit and statically reviewed CE hook boundary. Protected parameter aliases are expected and independently counted.

boundaries: One new diagnostic:3 fresh sequential fixed-pretrained-point CPU workers,9 backward policies; no optimizer/holdout forward or tuning.
Third-party patch/test assertions and upstream CI metadata are source evidence; no upstream runtime/log validation.
Raw rolling HTTP bodies remain ignored; selected fingerprints are not a complete public archive.
X current timeline unread after supported browser authentication failure; pages read0; employer remains unverified.
